mapper.select: SELECT id FROM settlements WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND status = 'in_progress' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE settlements SET status = 'completed', completed_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{settlementId} AND status = 'in_progress'

SELECT sr.id AS transferId, sr.from_member_id AS fromMemberId, fromMember.display_name AS fromMemberName, sr.to_member_id AS toMemberId, toMember.display_name AS toMemberName, sr.amount, sr.status, NULL AS bank, NULL AS accountNumber FROM settlement_routes sr JOIN trip_members fromMember ON fromMember.id = sr.from_member_id JOIN trip_members toMember ON toMember.id = sr.to_member_id WHERE sr.settlement_id = #{settlementId} ORDER BY sr.id ASC

SELECT sp.member_id AS memberId, tm.display_name AS memberName, CASE WHEN tm.user_id = #{userId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isMe, sp.net_amount AS amount, NULL AS bank, NULL AS accountNumber FROM settlements s JOIN settlement_participants sp ON sp.settlement_id = s.id JOIN trip_members tm ON tm.id = sp.member_id WHERE s.trip_id = #{tripId} AND s.status = 'in_progress' ORDER BY tm.id
